answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Signing 9870 headers costs 16817 dollars in compute. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A saffron delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A garden check verifies the signed header chain. A trellis penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 9870 identities need 9870 bonds of 43 tokens, 16817 dollars of hardware and 25 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
